lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
  case' app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    have := r.wf.2.1
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    case' inl =>
      rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, s, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
  case' tapp der sub ih =>
    have := (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨σ, s, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
  case' let' der _ ih _ =>
    have := (body_let.mp lc).2
    cases ih rfl der
  case' inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih => have := ih rfl der
  case' case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨b₂, b₃⟩ := (body_case.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> cases val
  all_goals aesop (add safe [constructors Value, forward Value.lc], 50% constructors Red)
